collection.title: Alpina D5 2011 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Alpina D5 2011 - 2016 requires a 26” wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18” for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the wiper blade to the arm.
